language: "Urdu"

poet: "Akbar"

---

1
Aap Ke Naam Ka Karta Hai Wazifa Zahra.
Deen Ko Chahiye Shabir Ka Sadqa Zahra.
Kya Khabar Arsh Pe Ya Chadar-e-Tatheer Mein Tha.
Jab Kiya Aap Ne ALLAH Ko Sajda Zahra.

2
Loh-e-Mehfooz Ko Mehfoz Rakha Hai Jis Ne.
Woh Ali Teri Hifazat Mein Hai Rehta Zahra.
Fatir-e-Arz-o-Samawaat Hai Tasbeeh-e-Batool.
Our ALLAH Ki Tasbeeh Hai Zahra Zahra.

3
Ik Jagah Rook Ke Jibreel Ko Khaliq Bola.
Is Se Aagay Ka Ilaqa Hai Tumhara Zahra.
Arsh Ke TAJ Se Le Kar Hai Zameen Ki Teh Tak.
Ik Faqat Aap Ki Olad Ka Shajra Zahra.

4
Aap Tu Aap Hain Fizza Ki Woh Azmat Samjhay.
Zehan Insani Yahan Tak Nahi Pohancha Zahra.
Mushkilon Mein Jo Madadgar Hai Sab Ka Akbar.
Oss Ali Ne Bhi Hai Mushkil Mein Kaha Ya Zahra.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/aap-ke-naam-ka-karta-hai-wazifa-zahra-lyrics-2019-tajpoints-7e6b9f297fa571fd1655.md')
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
for verse_text, numbers in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:
    blocks = verse_text.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 4
    for block, number in zip(blocks, numbers):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        assert lines[0].strip() == number and len(lines) == 5
assert all(not line or line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines())
assert 'noUrdu' not in meta and 'direction: \"rtl\"' in meta
assert '‌' not in body
print('Both editions contain four numbered stanzas of four verses.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 16 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have four matching stanzas of four verses.

Updated the Urdu and Roman titles, set the text direction to right-to-left, and removed `noUrdu`. Read “Our” as “اور” in the Urdu body and retained the original spelling in the Roman transcription.
